blocks.text: Lazy loading delays some images until they are near the visible area. This can save early work for a long page.

Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.

blocks.title: Load lower images later

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `loading="lazy"` lets the browser delay this image until it is near the visible area.

blocks.text: The browser may wait to load this lower image until the reader gets closer to it.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not lazy-load the main image people need immediately at the top of the page.
